doc.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

title: Iola as sounding board
summary: Rowe notes Mel Torme's summer Christmas song and Iola's role as partner; Brubeck says she usually likes everything but disliked this morning's piece.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I think, didn’t Mel Torme and his partner write “The Christmas Song” in the middle of July too, sitting by a swimming pool?
But it sounds like Mrs. Brubeck has been a very valuable sounding board and partner in all respects.
Yeah. Except this morning when she didn’t like my new piece. Because she usually likes everything you know and will give me suggestions. But she said, “don’t let anybody sing that, that’s too sad.”
Well you can’t fault her for her honesty.
